{{Quote|You're looking for ravinaks, right?|A Mythrol to a landspeeder pilot|audio=Mythrol-Ravinaks.flac|<ref name="Chapter 1" />}}
'''Ravinaks''' were large [[reptile]]s<ref name="Topps" /> that inhabited the [[Temperature|frigid]] [[planet]]<ref name="Chapter 1" /> [[Pagodon]],<ref name="Mandalorian handbook" /> swimming underneath the [[Water|ice]]. 

==Biology and appearance==
They had two large [[Tooth|tusks]], a [[Nose|blowhole]] on top of their head, and [[Color|gray]] skin. The creatures were known to be prevalent around the local [[Spaceport|port]], as crews would often dump their gray holds out, creating a [[Foodstuff|food]] supply for the [[Diet|carnivores]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />  Their thick hides protected them against attack, and a series of spikes on the animal's spine discouraged dorsal attacks. Ravinaks had two strong pectoral fins that ended with six sharp claws. They used these claws along with twin tusks to attack their prey.<ref name="Bestiary" />

==History==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|1|the appearance of the ravinak}}</ref> a ravinak attacked a [[landspeeder]], destroying the craft and [[Death|killing]] its [[human]] [[Unidentified human speeder pilot|pilot]]. The ravinak then attacked the ''[[Razor Crest]]'', a [[gunship]] flown by the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]], who was attempting to leave the planet with his [[Mythrol]] [[The Fledgling Mythrol|bounty]]. The ravinak grasped the landing gear of the ''Razor Crest'' as it was mid-flight and began pulling it down, but it was repelled by the Mandalorian's [[Amban phase-pulse blaster]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ravinak appeared in the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', titled "[[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian]],"<ref name="Chapter 1" /> which was made available on [[Disney+]] on [[November 12]], [[2019]].<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1 p. 1]|archivedate=20210623202717}}</ref>
